name: Fudeoroshi Mama ~Afureru Hakudaku & Milk~
original_name: 筆下ろしママ ～溢れる白濁＆ミルク～
source:
The protagonist is someone who likes older women, and he's very popular among the mothers. So naturally, he grows up to be a mothercon. He also has a burning desire to lose his virginity to them. Then one day, an unexpected chance appears.

[Translated from [url=http://incarose-soft.com/fudemama/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公喜欢年长女性，在母亲们之间非常受欢迎。因此，他自然而然地成长为恋母者，也强烈渴望失去处男之身时对象就是她们。然后，有一天，一个意外的机会出现了。

[译自[url=http://incarose-soft.com/fudemama/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
